info.title: Novel Bot API
info.description:
Register an account, log in, then generate API keys for application access. Login sessions authorize account/key management; application API keys authorize automation API routes. Application API keys can create isolated headless Chromium sessions and connect through authenticated CDP WebSocket proxies. Redis tracks ownership and worker capacity, allowing creation, connection, and deletion through any API replica.

Use Authorize to paste raw token values without the Bearer prefix. Authorization is not persisted across page reloads.

post.description: Returns a revocable login session. Sessions expire after SESSION_TTL (24 hours by default). Use access_token to authorize LoginSession.

post.description: Revokes this login session immediately for subsequent requests. Other sessions and application API keys remain active. Reusing this revoked token returns 401.

204.description: Operation completed. Response body is empty.

post.description: Requires a login session. The key always belongs to your account client. The secret is returned only once; store it securely.

201.description: API key created. Secret shown only in this response.

Location.description: Path identifying the new key for revocation.

requestBody.description: Send one JSON object, at most 16 KiB. Unknown fields are rejected.

get.description: Lists metadata for your client, including expired and revoked keys. Never returns API key secrets or hashes.

200.description: Your key metadata. Empty list if there are no keys.

delete.description: Revokes an owned key. Repeating revocation of an owned key succeeds. Another account cannot revoke your key; other-account IDs return 404.

204.description: Operation completed. Response body is empty.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Key metadata ID, not the full API key secret.

get.description: Use an API key through Authorization: Bearer or X-API-Key. Send exactly one credential header. Login tokens are rejected.
Public probe; does not contact the database.
Checks PostgreSQL authentication schema availability, Redis connectivity, and the local browser worker lease.

post.description: Creates one isolated headless Chromium process. PostgreSQL stores tenant policies; Redis atomically enforces tenant concurrency and creation rate limits while reserving an available worker. Defaults per tenant: 5 starting/active sessions, 30 valid creation attempts per minute, and a maximum 15-minute browser lifetime. Rate budgets count attempts denied by tenant concurrency or worker capacity. The effective lifetime is the smaller of the tenant limit and BROWSER_SESSION_TTL. Returns an authenticated CDP proxy URL; expires_at is authoritative. Deletion, expiry, failed startup, and worker lease loss release quota. No caller-supplied launch flags or lifetime overrides are accepted.

201.description: Browser ready for CDP connections. Send the same application API key in the WebSocket handshake.

Location.description: Proxy path for this browser session.

get.summary: Connect to the browser over CDP WebSocket
get.description: Requires a WebSocket upgrade with Authorization: Bearer API_KEY or X-API-Key. Login tokens are not accepted. Connection closes on deletion, expiry, process exit, or server shutdown. Other tenants receive 404. Swagger Try it out does not establish WebSockets; use Playwright or a CDP client. Any API replica can route the connection to the owning worker using Redis. Missing or expired worker leases return 404. Private worker credentials are not exposed to clients.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Browser session ID returned by POST /sessions.

101.description: WebSocket upgraded; CDP frames are proxied bidirectionally.

404.description: Session missing, stopped, expired, or owned by another client.

delete.summary: Terminate Chromium and remove its temporary profile
delete.description: Terminates the owned browser and its active CDP connections. Missing sessions or sessions owned by other clients return 404. Any API replica forwards termination to the owning worker. New session operations require Redis availability.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Browser session ID returned by POST /sessions.

LoginSession.description: Paste access_token returned by POST /v1/auth/login. Used only for account and API key management. Starts with nb_session_.

ApplicationBearer.description: Paste api_key returned by POST /v1/api-keys. Used for application routes. Starts with nb_key_.

ApplicationKeyHeader.name: X-API-Key
ApplicationKeyHeader.description: Alternative application key header. Paste the complete API key value. Use one application credential method at a time.

Name.description: 1 to 100 Unicode characters after trimming surrounding whitespace.

Password.description: Registration requires 12 to 72 UTF-8 bytes. Passwords are not trimmed and never returned.

access_token.description: Opaque login token. Paste this value into LoginSession authorization without the Bearer prefix.

ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime in seconds, up to 90 days. Omit or use null for the default.

api_key.description: The complete secret, returned only on issuance. Save it securely.

message.example: A valid login session is required

cdp_url.description: Authenticated worker proxy WebSocket URL. Send the application API key in the connection headers.

BadRequest.description: Request validation failed. Unsupported fields, malformed JSON, invalid names, or TTL values are rejected.

EmailRegistered.description: An account already exists for this normalized email address.

InvalidCredentials.description: Invalid email or password. Unknown email addresses and wrong passwords have the same response.

SessionUnauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked login token; application API keys cannot authorize account operations.

error.message: A valid login session is required

KeyUnauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked API key; login tokens cannot authorize application operations.

error.message: A valid API key is required

NotFound.description: Key does not exist or belongs to another account.

Unavailable.description: Database operation failed or timed out, or Redis admission is unavailable (rate_limiter_unavailable). Requests fail closed. Try again later.

NotReady.description: The database or authentication schema is unavailable.

MethodNotAllowed.description: HTTP method is not supported for this route.

Allow.description: Supported HTTP methods for this route.

AuthenticationRateLimited.description: Authentication/account request budget exceeded for the client IP, shared across all API replicas. Default: 30 requests per minute. Rejected requests do not extend the window.

SessionAdmissionLimited.description: Tenant exceeded its concurrent browser limit (including starting sessions) or session creation rate. Defaults: 5 sessions and 30 valid creation attempts per minute. API keys for the same tenant share both budgets.

BrowserUnavailable.description: Worker capacity exhausted (session_capacity_reached, with Retry-After), browser execution unavailable, or tenant policy/Redis admission unavailable. Tenant quota and rate rejections use 429.
